import {
  resolveShifuCachedTool, observeQualifiedCoreCheckout,
  downloadGithubArtifact, downloadHttpArtifact, discoverGithubBundle,
  materializeQualifiedCoreBundle, consumeQualifiedCoreForCheckout,
  qualifiedCoreUsageStatus, runQualifiedCoreUsageStatusCommand,
} from '@kungfu-tech/work/assignment-capture/qualified-assignment-core-consumer';

const checkout = observeQualifiedCoreCheckout('.');
const commit: string = checkout.commit;
const tool: string = resolveShifuCachedTool({ tool: 'uv' });
const github: Promise<string> = downloadGithubArtifact({
  repository: checkout.repository, artifactId: 1, destination: '/tmp/archive',
});
const http: Promise<string> = downloadHttpArtifact({
  url: 'https://example.invalid/archive', destination: '/tmp/archive', expectedBytes: 1,
});
const bundle = await discoverGithubBundle(checkout, '/tmp', { cacheRoot: '/tmp/cache' });
const materialized = await materializeQualifiedCoreBundle({
  bundleRoot: bundle.bundleRoot, repositoryRoot: '.', checkout, cacheRoot: '/tmp/cache',
});
const status: 'materialized' | 'already-materialized' = materialized.status;
const consumed = await consumeQualifiedCoreForCheckout({ repositoryRoot: '.', checkout });
const objectRoot: string = consumed.objectRoot;
const eligible: boolean = qualifiedCoreUsageStatus({ repositoryRoot: '.' }).currentCheckout.eligible;
const observations: number = runQualifiedCoreUsageStatusCommand(['status']).totals.observations;
// @ts-expect-error repositoryRoot is required.
consumeQualifiedCoreForCheckout({});
// @ts-expect-error archive byte count is numeric.
downloadHttpArtifact({ url: 'https://example.invalid', destination: '/tmp/a', expectedBytes: '1' });
// @ts-expect-error CLI arguments must be strings.
runQualifiedCoreUsageStatusCommand([1]);
// @ts-expect-error Private implementation paths are not public type entries.
import '@kungfu-tech/work/assignment-capture/qualified-assignment-core-consumer.mjs';
